data.title: 白井黑子 · 宿舍阳台晚风中的红茶回眸
data.description: 常盘台学生宿舍静谧的夜间阳台，微凉夜风拂过茶色双马尾发丝。黑子换上了便服格子衬衫与小百褶裙，双手托着温热的瓷茶杯，倚在雕花栏杆旁。没有了风纪委员臂章的束缚，红棕色的美眸在柔和灯光下显得格外澄澈柔美，唇角挂着只对特定之人展现的静谧微笑。
data.location: classical elegant academy dorm balcony overlooking night city lights
data.action: leaning on decorative dorm balcony railing holding tea cup, plaid casual blouse, twin braids fluttering in night breeze, tender gentle smile
data.lighting: cool city skyline luminescence paired with warm vintage terrace light
data.mood: peaceful off-duty refinement, gentle romantic trust
data.promptProse: Leaning gracefully against a dorm balcony railing holding a delicate teacup, Kuroko Shirai wears a casual plaid blouse. Her brown twintails drift in the night breeze as she looks forward with a soft, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Kuroko standing on a night balcony with a cup of tea in a casual blouse, smiling softly.
